newsitem.title: UK: Britons leave 77 billion stg unclaimed - report.
newsitem.headline: Britons leave 77 billion stg unclaimed - report.

text.p: Britons have left unclaimed a staggering 77 billion pounds ($121.5 billion) worth of forgotten fortunes in bank accounts and shares, a market survey showed on Tuesday.
This would be enough to pay the income tax of everyone in the country for a year or release sufficient funds to build seven more Channel tunnels between France and Britain.

The Mintel survey showed that Britons have lost track of almost 55 billion pounds saved with banks, building societies, national savings and in stocks and shares. Many flotation benefits have never been claimed.

Over 22 billion pounds are waiting to be claimed from the National Lottery, bookmakers and company benefits like pension entitlements, Mintel said in its survey conducted for independent financial advisers.
